classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate 1–2 binder candidates against a provided target structure using BindCraft, score interface confidence with ipSAE on each, and rank the small candidate set.
assumptions: target_pdb must be provided at runtime; no default is assumed and it is listed in missing_inputs.
No hotspot residues are supplied; BindCraft will explore the full target surface for interface contacts.
Two independent BindCraft trajectory shards (seeds 1 and 2), each targeting one final design, produce exactly two candidates—matching the compact scope requested.
Binder length defaults to 60 residues (BindCraft default) and is exposed as a tunable workflow parameter.
Target occupies chain A and the designed binder occupies chain B in the predicted complex; ipSAE chain assignments follow this convention.
num_recycles=1 and filter_mode='default' minimise runtime while preserving standard BindCraft quality gating.
Both BindCraft shards may execute in parallel (default_max_parallel=2 per tool sharding metadata).
rank_designs with top_k=2 returns both candidates in score order; final submission is a post-round decision and is excluded from this plan.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target structure PDB file (required by bindcraft; no executable default available)
